title: Dukumentiyada Riftn — Hagayaal, Calaamad, dApps & FAQ
description: Dukumentiyada rasmiga ah ee Riftn: dulmarka madasha, dApps, dhaqaalaha calaamadda (token), staking, ciyaaraha, khariidadda waddada, FAQ iyo in ka badan.
body:
Wax walba oo aad u baahan tahay si aad u isticmaasho, isku darsato, dhisto, oo u ballaarisid madalkeena. Laga bilaabo hagayaasha bilow degdeg ilaa qaabeynta hore.

Degdeg & La isku halayn karo

Lagu dhisay silsiladaha ugu badbaadsan iyo ugu degdegsan ee L1 iyo EVM L2.

Ammaan

Haystayaasha token-ka waxay ku maamulaan node-yaal adduunka oo dhan si ay u shaqeysiiyaan shabakadda oo ay abaal-marin helaan.

Taageerada Horumariyaha

Waxaan maalgelinaa mashruucyada iyo dadaalada bulshada.

Bulshada

Bulsho xoog leh oo taageero leh tan iyo 2021.

Riftn: Internetkii hore wuu dildillaacayaa. Dhul cusub ayaa soo baxaya.
